MeetRoom redesign: CSS custom properties design system, no framework

extra.detail: Rebuilt legacy Angular 2 + Bootstrap "Hotel Empire" theme as pure static HTML/CSS/JS. Key decisions: (1) CSS custom properties as design tokens — single source of truth for all colors/spacing/shadows; (2) Skeleton loaders via shimmer animation before API data loads; (3) Delegated event listeners on room card grid for reserve button clicks (not per-card); (4) escapeHtml() via createTextNode for all user/API data to prevent XSS; (5) IIFE modules (rooms page, reservations page) in one shared app.js file, guarded by checking for page-specific DOM elements.
